test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the term of office of the Chief Election Commissioner of India?

options.text: Six year term or continue till the age of 70, whichever is earlier.
Four year term or continue till the age of 60, whichever is earlier.
Five year term or continue till the age of 65, whichever is earlier.
Six year term or continue till the age of 65, whichever is earlier.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Six year term or continue till the age of 65, whichever is earlier.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) of India is **appointed by the President of India.**
 
• The CEC serves for a **term of six years** but may continue in office until the **age of 65 years**, whichever comes first.
 
• They enjoy the same **status and receive salary and perks** as available to** Judges of the Supreme Court **of India.
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner is supported by **two Election Commissioners,** who are also appointed by the President, and together they form the Election Commission of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Election Commission of India(ECI) is a **permanent constitutional body **created in **1950 **according to constitutional provisions.
 
• **Part XV **of the Indian Constitution deals with ECI.
 
• It is an all-India body that is common to both Central and state.
 
• **Article 324** of the Indian constitution deals with the ECI.
 
• It is responsible for the conduction of elections for both the houses of** Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha** as well as **state legislative assemblies.**
 
• It is also responsible for the elections for** president, vice president, and legislative assemblies for union territories.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
